module_catalog.name: Advanced e-publishing 712
module_catalog.content: The aim of this module is to further familiarise students with the development, economics and delivery of digital publications. Students develop strong e-production skills through hands-on implementation of publication workflows for various electronic publications. Students also implement a business plan for the accessibility, distribution and marketing of these publications.
module_catalog.service_modules: Faculty of Economic and Management Sciences

module_catalog.name: Editorial practice: List building and acquisition of rights 729
module_catalog.content: This module builds on students’ knowledge of and skills in commissioning and acquisitions, with a particular focus on strategic and financial aspects of publishing list building, and acquisition policies and procedures. The module also addresses copyright and subsidiary rights.
module_catalog.contact_time: 3 lectures per meeting, 8 meetings over 14 weeks

module_catalog.name: Book history 732
module_catalog.content: This module provides an introduction to the history of the book, examining key themes of book production, distribution, authorship and reading. Attention is also given to the development of a textual and print culture in South Africa.
module_catalog.contact_time: 3 lectures per meeting, 8 meetings over 14 weeks
